results.question: What is blocking Project Atlas?
results.answer: Project Atlas is blocked by the following tickets: [ATL-112], [ATL-121], and [ATL-136]. [ATL-112] is blocking [ATL-118], [ATL-121], [ATL-127], and [ATL-133]. The reason for [ATL-112] being blocked is that the vendor PayGate has not delivered sandbox credentials for v2; the contract amendment is still pending. The ticket [ATL-112] is overdue by 20 days.
